digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 22 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Python, Rust, TypeScript）和 11 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「Agent 技能与工具」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills
repos.description: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls.
repos.summary_zh: 单文件 CLAUDE.md 直击 LLM 编码常见陷阱，用 Karpathy 的观察让 Claude Code 少犯低级错误

repos.name: anomalyco/opencode
repos.description: The open source coding agent.
repos.summary_zh: 开源 TypeScript 编码智能体，让开发者用自然语言直接驱动代码生成与修改

repos.name: Graphify-Labs/graphify
repos.description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex,
repos.summary_zh: 把代码库连同文档、SQL、配置和PDF一键转成可查询知识图谱，为Claude Code等AI编程工具提供本地确定性AST解析能力

repos.name: TauricResearch/TradingAgents
repos.description: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
repos.summary_zh: 多智能体LLM金融交易框架，用多个AI角色分工协作模拟真实交易决策流程

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.name: xerj-org/xerj
repos.description: Local-first search engine and MCP server for AI agents. One Rust binary indexes code, docs, logs, JSONL/CSV and PDFs for BM25 full-text, vector and hy
repos.summary_zh: 单文件 Rust 二进制为 AI Agent 提供本地优先的混合检索，免 grep 搜代码、文档、日志与 PDF，并内置 MCP 服务

repos.name: ModernRelay/omnigraph
repos.description: Object-storage native graph database with branching and typed ontology
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 打造的对象存储原生图数据库，支持分支与类型化本体，让图数据像代码一样版本化管理

repos.name: kividbio/kividb
repos.description: A fast, multi-threaded Redis® and Valkey alternative written in Rust: drop-in compatible, with full-text and vector search built in
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 写的多线程 Redis/Valkey 替代品，可直接替换且内置全文与向量搜索

repos.name: cdcailf/cjkfold
repos.description: Fold look-alike CJK glyphs (Kangxi radicals, CJK radical supplements) so text extracted from PDFs matches again.
repos.summary_zh: 专治 PDF 提取文本中康熙部首等形近 CJK 字形不匹配问题，用 NFKC 折叠让检索重新对齐

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施
categories.desc: 压缩、转换、整理输入，降低 Token 成本，加速推理

repos.name: vllm-project/vllm
repos.description: A high-throughput and memory-efficient inference and serving engine for LLMs
repos.summary_zh: 面向大模型推理的高吞吐显存优化引擎，用 PagedAttention 大幅提升服务吞吐并降低显存占用

repos.name: tashfeenahmed/freellmapi
repos.description: 7.4 billion tokens per month. 34 free LLM providers. 635 free model endpoints. All behind one /v1 endpoint, plus any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint
repos.summary_zh: 聚合34家免费LLM供应商共635个模型端点于单一/v1接口，支持智能路由与自动故障转移，月省74亿Token

repos.name: sgl-project/sglang
repos.description: SGLang is a high-performance serving framework for large language models and multimodal models.
repos.summary_zh: 高性能大模型与多模态模型推理服务框架，专注高吞吐低延迟的规模化部署

repos.name: StartLuxLabs/StartLux-Decision
repos.description: Open decision models from 0.8B to 27B: a calibrated probability for every option in one pass, and a short thought only when unsure. Engine for vLLM, l
repos.summary_zh: 一次推理给出所有选项的校准概率，仅在不确定时才生成简短思考，支持vLLM、llama.cpp和MLX

categories.name: 🔬 模型训练与微调
categories.desc: 预训练、微调、对齐、评估等模型构建环节

repos.name: Folkbench/folkbench
repos.description: AI API 中转站评测排行与切换工具：实测可用率、延迟与价格 · Open-source AI API relay benchmark, rankings & switcher for Claude Code / Codex
repos.summary_zh: 实测各家 AI API 中转站的可用率、延迟与价格并一键切换，帮 Claude Code 和 Codex 用户挑出最稳最划算的接口

repos.name: FrontiersMindAI/decisionformer
repos.description: Transformers for decision models: fine-tune, load and serve calibrated decsion-model on any Hugging Face model.
repos.summary_zh: 让决策模型像大模型一样微调部署，在任意 Hugging Face 模型上加载并服务校准后的决策模型

categories.name: 🎨 应用与前端
categories.desc: 面向终端用户的 AI 应用、UI 组件、聊天界面

repos.name: Comfy-Org/ComfyUI
repos.description: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface. The fastest local inference engine in the world.
repos.summary_zh: 最强大模块化扩散模型图形界面，用节点式工作流实现全球最快本地推理

repos.name: luongnv89/claude-howto
repos.description: A visual, example-driven guide to Claude Code — from basic concepts to advanced agents, with copy-paste templates that bring immediate value.
repos.summary_zh: 用可视化示例和即拷即用模板带你从零掌握 Claude Code 直至进阶智能体

repos.name: thesysdev/openui
repos.description: The Open Standard for Generative UI
repos.summary_zh: 让大模型直接生成可交互 UI 的开放标准，把 AI 输出从纯文本升级为可操作界面

repos.name: harry0703/MangoDisk
repos.description: Safety-first disk cleaner and space analyzer for macOS, Windows and Linux, with duplicate cleanup, app uninstall, startup management, system optimizat
repos.summary_zh: 跨平台安全优先的磁盘清理与空间分析工具，Rust 编写，集重复文件清理、应用卸载、启动项管理与系统优化于一体

categories.name: 📦 其他热门
categories.desc: 值得关注的其他 AI/ML 开源项目

repos.name: iptv-org/iptv
repos.description: Collection of publicly available IPTV channels from all over the world
repos.summary_zh: 汇集全球公开 IPTV 频道并自动校验可用性，一份订阅源搞定世界各地电视直播

repos.name: fastapi/fastapi
repos.description: FastAPI framework, high performance, easy to learn, fast to code, ready for production
repos.summary_zh: 高性能Python Web框架，自动生成API文档，类型提示驱动开发，开箱即用适合生产部署

repos.name: oven-sh/bun
repos.description: Incredibly fast JavaScript runtime, bundler, test runner, and package manager – all in one
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 打造的超快 JavaScript 运行时，集打包、测试、包管理于一体，一个工具替代 Node、Webpack、Jest 和 npm

repos.name: pbakaus/impeccable
repos.description: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.
repos.summary_zh: 让 AI 编码工具真正懂设计的 Rust 设计语言，把 AI 生成界面的审美从能用提升到好看

papers.abstract: Generative recommenders retrieve items by writing their semantic IDs (SIDs) code by code under trie-constrained beam search, an approach now deployed on large web platforms. Standard autoregressive in
papers.summary_zh: 提出将思考与拼写分离的高效生成式推荐框架，避免SID长度重复计算，显著降低推理开销

papers.title: Flownomaly: Single-Step Conditional-Mean Recovery for Few-Shot Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract: Few-shot industrial anomaly detection requires modeling category-specific normality from only a handful of defect-free images. Common approaches tie inference to stored exemplars, impose rigid linear
papers.summary_zh: 提出单步条件均值恢复的少样本异常检测方法Flownomaly，摆脱对样本库依赖并避免重构异常内容

papers.title: Where Rounding Happens Matters: Rounding-Location Alignment Stabilizes LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning for large language models often uses separate systems for inference and training. Even with identical weights and BF16 tensors, implementation differences can make an intended o
papers.summary_zh: 揭示推理与训练系统舍入位置差异导致策略偏离，提出舍入位置对齐方法稳定大模型强化学习训练

papers.title: Yalda-Embedding: Open Development of a Competitive Persian Retrieval Model
papers.abstract: Despite advances in multilingual text representations, effective dense retrieval for Persian remains constrained by the limited availability of language-specific training resources and compact embeddi
papers.summary_zh: 提出面向波斯语检索的595.8M参数嵌入模型并开放开发流程，缓解语言资源稀缺下稠密检索受限问题

papers.title: Closing the Modality Gap via Simplex-Constrained Representations
papers.abstract: While multimodal contrastive models like CLIP and CLAP successfully learn shared representations, their embeddings typically exhibit a persistent \emph{modality gap}. We propose addressing this separa
papers.summary_zh: 提出单纯形约束表示方法替代单位球嵌入域以消除多模态对比模型的模态间隔

papers.title: SceneBloom: Agentic Indoor Environment Generation with Realistic and Diverse Layouts for Embodied Learning
papers.abstract: Training generalizable embodied agents requires realistic, varied, and simulation-ready indoor environments. Language-guided methods support semantic planning and object-level reasoning, but precise s
papers.summary_zh: 提出场景生成智能体框架SceneBloom，融合语言引导与视觉先验实现精确空间布局，生成真实多样且可直接仿真的室内环境用于具身学习

papers.title: Measure Before You Train: Typed Decision Models vs. a Classical Baseline vs. a Generative LLM for Routing a Personal Multilingual Inbox
papers.abstract: Personal email agents decide, for every message, what it is, whether it is urgent, whether to draft a reply, create a task, or ignore it. Their error rate is rarely measured: the stored labels were wr
papers.summary_zh: 提出Foyer自托管邮件代理并系统测量路由误差，用类型化决策模型对比经典基线与生成式大模型，揭示存储标签自评偏差问题

papers.title: Beyond Discrete Tokens: Preserving Numerical Continuity in Medical Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Objective: To develop a unified vision-language model for prompt-conditioned quantitative ultrasound measurement that addresses the mismatch between continuous measurement targets and discrete token-b
papers.summary_zh: 提出混合自回归扩散医学视觉语言模型HAD-VLM，以连续数值生成替代离散token预测，解决超声定量测量中连续目标与离散预测的失配问题

papers.title: The Language of Instruction: Genre and Generative AI
papers.abstract: This article argues that instruction-fine-tuned language models should be understood as implementing a genre, what is proposed as the instructional-conversational genre. This genre is an amalgamation
papers.summary_zh: 提出将指令微调语言模型理解为实现指令对话文体的新视角，揭示其话语源自人机对话的递归融合

papers.title: RobustRLlib: A Unified Library and Benchmark for Robust Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
papers.abstract: Robust reinforcement learning (RL) is critical for reliable real-world deployment, where policies may fail under diverse shifts and disruptions. Existing robust RL algorithms offer a rich set of mecha

papers.title: DexPort: A Hand-Held Skill Interface for Dexterous Hand Data Collection
papers.abstract: Collecting high-quality demonstrations remains a central bottleneck for learning dexterous manipulation. Teleoperation records executable robot actions, but it requires a complete robot setup and plac
